attributes.board_name: DC Board of Veterinary Medicine (DC Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved continuing education per 17 DCMR § 11212 (e.g. AAVSB RACE-approved programs)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first renewal of a certificate.

topics.who: LGBTQ continuing education, all certificate holders
10% of the required hours in the Director's published public health priority subjects

rules.notes: 14 hours in the two years before the certificate expires, including 2 hours LGBTQ and 10% in DC public health priorities. Since June 16, 2024 DC Health credentials expire on the last day of the holder's birth month. Reinstatement: 7 hours per year expired.
rules.rule_quote: To qualify for the renewal of a certificate, an applicant shall have completed fourteen (14) hours of approved continuing education, including two (2) hours of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transexual, or Gay (“LGBTQ”) continuing education, during the two (2) year period preceding the date the license expires.
